summary:
Comprehensive architectural refactoring plan for Golf Clash / Ultimate Golf style arcade footgolf mechanics. Covers:
- State Machine (Aiming -> Pullback -> Timing Window -> BallFlight)
- Inverse Drag-and-Release Pullback with 0-100% standard power & 100-125% Overpower scaling
- Ground Concentric Bullseye Reticle with rapid oscillating timing needle
- Arcade Timing Engine (Perfect, Great, Good, Hook/Slice with deterministic lateral physics deviation)
- Dedicated Putting Pullback Subsystem with cup capture velocity tolerance
- Pure Headless Physics Engine decoupled from Three.js rendering for server-side validation
- Detailed verification & test suite plan
